**This card waits behind two in-flight cards in this lane.** Both hold files it will touch:
- #20555 holds `security-plugin.ts` (claim `5883430106`). That is where `explainAccessForCaller` lives.
- #20431 holds `explain-engine.ts` (claim `5883945566`). That is where `buildContextForUser` lives.

Fold-or-serial is answered **serial**: triage ruled the seams separate (`5883891098`). This card is dispatched when both of those have landed or closed.

**Known pitfalls, recorded now so the dispatch does not rediscover them:**
1. #20555 may change how `resolvePermissionSetsForContext*` scopes an organization-less principal's sets, and the explainer consumes that through `buildContextForUser`. Re-read the explained-principal path after #20555 lands. Do not rely on the pointer `5882596659`'s reading.
2. #20431 changes the record attribution in `explain-engine.ts`. Merge `main` before building on that file.
3. PR #20540 (`f6ceddc3`) already gave `buildContextForUser` an optional `tenantId`, which is option (b). This card's direction ("the same membership check enforcement applies, ⛔ no second membership rule") starts from that signature.

(stop on a breach outside these; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier` at `7001918e`: no path-derived mandate, floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable; explain-versus-enforce parity on the principal-resolution path is design judgment ⇒ the default tier)
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Thread-read: 5883972548
Serial constraints cleared: both predecessors have landed, #20555 (PR #20584, `6e3aa75e`) and #20431 (PR #20598, `7001918e`). No open PR touches `plugin-security/src` or `packages/core/src/security`. This seat's in-flight #20596 holds `service-messaging` only, so it is disjoint. #20604 (the explain-versus-enforce closeout, bare) follows this card in `explain-engine.ts`.

Correction, made in place by this seat after reading PR #20614 at head `bd7b4677`: the `Clause-②` line was `no`. The fix exports one new function from `@objectstack/core`'s entry, `vetOrganizationClaim`, lifting `resolveAuthzContext`'s session-arm check verbatim, as the claim's `packages/core` exception allowed. That widens a published surface, so the line now reads `yes (widening)`, and the changeset already grades `@objectstack/core` `minor`. The PR body line is corrected in the same act as this edit.
